challenges.claim: flash the light once — on, then off
challenges.symptom: the light turns on and just stays on
challenges.fix: Add a 'turn LED off' step after the wait, so the flash actually ends.
challenges.why: Turning something on is only half a flash. A flash is a change: on, then off.

challenges.claim: drive forward, then turn right toward the desk
challenges.symptom: it drives up but then turns away from the desk
challenges.fix: Change the turn from LEFT to RIGHT.
challenges.why: Left and right send the robot to opposite headings; the direction word is the whole instruction.

challenges.claim: lift the pen first so the robot moves without drawing
challenges.symptom: it draws a line across the paper while it moves
challenges.fix: Put 'pen up' before 'move forward', not after.
challenges.why: The pen is still down during the move. Order decides what has happened by the time each step runs.

challenges.claim: turn the light on to signal, then drive off
challenges.symptom: it drives off first and the light comes on afterwards
challenges.fix: Swap the two steps: 'turn LED on' should come before 'move forward'.
challenges.why: A signal that arrives after the action isn't a signal. The order is the meaning.

challenges.claim: the robot should start with its pen lifted
challenges.symptom: it leaves ink from the very first move
challenges.fix: Add a 'pen up' step at the start so the pen begins in a known position.
challenges.why: If you never set the starting state, the robot keeps whatever state it had before.

challenges.claim: drive a square — four equal sides
challenges.symptom: it draws only three sides and leaves the square open
challenges.fix: Change the loop from 'repeat 3' to 'repeat 4'.
challenges.why: A square has four sides, so the move-and-turn pair must run four times, not three.

challenges.claim: climb exactly 5 steps
challenges.symptom: it climbs 6 and topples off the top
challenges.fix: Change 'repeat 6' to 'repeat 5'.
challenges.why: The loop count is the number of steps. One too many and you walk off the edge.

challenges.claim: walk a staircase: move up one, then step to the right
challenges.symptom: it steps right first each time and drifts off the stairs
challenges.fix: Swap the two steps inside the loop so 'move forward' comes before 'turn RIGHT'.
challenges.why: The wrong order repeats every pass, so a small mistake becomes a big drift.

challenges.claim: count 4 tiles each run, starting the count from zero
challenges.symptom: on the second run it counts from where the last one stopped
challenges.fix: Add 'set count to 0' before the loop.
challenges.why: A variable keeps its old value unless you reset it; each run must start it clean.

challenges.claim: stamp a 3 by 3 grid of dots — nine in all
challenges.symptom: each row only has two dots, so a whole column is missing
challenges.fix: Change the inner loop from 'repeat 2' to 'repeat 3'.
challenges.why: The inner loop fills a row; two passes make two dots, not three.

challenges.claim: stop before the wall
challenges.symptom: it drives straight into the wall
challenges.fix: Read the distance INSIDE the loop so it is checked on every pass.
challenges.why: A check only protects you if it runs on every iteration; read once and the robot drives blind.

challenges.claim: stop when the wall is closer than 3 cm
challenges.symptom: it stops too late and taps the wall
challenges.fix: Change the threshold from 2 back to 3.
challenges.why: A smaller stopping distance lets the robot get closer before it reacts.

challenges.claim: slow down when a wall is near — distance less than 5
challenges.symptom: it slows down only in open space and speeds up near walls
challenges.fix: Swap the comparison: it should be 'distance < 5', not 'distance > 5'.
challenges.why: The greater-than test is true exactly when you are far away — the opposite of 'near'.

challenges.claim: keep moving while the path ahead is clear
challenges.symptom: it refuses to move until something is right in front of it
challenges.fix: Change 'repeat until' to 'repeat while' — move WHILE clear, not UNTIL clear.
challenges.why: 'Until clear' loops only while blocked, which is the exact reverse of what you wanted.

challenges.claim: follow the line, checking the line sensor at every step
challenges.symptom: it reads the line once, then wanders off it
challenges.fix: Move the line read inside the loop so it happens on every pass.
challenges.why: A single reading tells you where the line was at the start, not where it is now.

challenges.claim: turn the brake light on only when very close — distance under 4
challenges.symptom: the light flickers on far too early
challenges.fix: Change the threshold from 5 to 4.
challenges.why: A larger cutoff triggers sooner, so the light comes on before the robot is really close.

challenges.claim: always begin a run at a known, gentle speed
challenges.symptom: the second run starts fast, keeping the last run's speed
challenges.fix: Add 'set speed 3' before the loop so every run starts the same.
challenges.why: Motor speed is state too; if you don't set it, it keeps whatever it was left on.

challenges.claim: drop to the low gear before driving up the ramp
challenges.symptom: it hits the ramp at full speed, then downshifts too late
challenges.fix: Set the low gear before the move, not after it.
challenges.why: A gear change only helps the climbing that comes after it.

challenges.claim: sweep the servo across all 6 positions
challenges.symptom: it stops one short and never reaches the last position
challenges.fix: Change 'repeat 5' to 'repeat 6' so it visits every position.
challenges.why: Six positions need six steps; five leaves the final angle unvisited.

challenges.claim: steer the wheels to curve right, around the pole
challenges.symptom: it curves left and clips the pole
challenges.fix: Change the steering from LEFT to RIGHT.
challenges.why: Steering the wrong way each pass bends the whole path to the wrong side.

challenges.claim: cut the motor when the battery drops below 20
challenges.symptom: it cuts out when the battery is full and runs it flat when low
challenges.fix: Swap the comparison to 'battery < 20'.
challenges.why: Greater-than fires when charge is high — the opposite of a low-battery cutoff, and it can damage the pack.

challenges.claim: stay in PATROL while no target is seen
challenges.symptom: it only patrols after it has already spotted a target
challenges.fix: Change 'repeat until' to 'repeat while' — patrol WHILE nothing is seen.
challenges.why: 'Until no target' runs only while a target IS seen, which inverts the whole behaviour.

challenges.claim: each run should begin in the IDLE state
challenges.symptom: it starts in whatever state the last run happened to end in
challenges.fix: Add 'set state to IDLE' before the loop.
challenges.why: A state machine that is never reset carries its old state into the next run.

challenges.claim: raise the flag light first, then start the timer
challenges.symptom: the timer starts before the flag ever goes up
challenges.fix: Put 'turn LED on' before the timer wait.
challenges.why: An event handler runs its steps in order; the flag must be raised before the wait begins.

challenges.claim: poll the sensor 10 times, then report
challenges.symptom: it reports after only 9 reads and misses the last one
challenges.fix: Change 'repeat 9' to 'repeat 10'.
challenges.why: The loop count is exactly how many samples you take; nine passes give nine reads.

challenges.claim: the helper 'is far' should be true when distance is more than 15
challenges.symptom: the helper says 'far' when the robot is actually close
challenges.fix: Swap the comparison inside the helper to 'distance > 15'.
challenges.why: A helper with a flipped test is wrong everywhere it is called — fix it once, fix it everywhere.
